description: List workouts/activities (runs, rides, swims, strength...) as dense summaries: id, date, type, name, duration, distance, pace or speed, GAP, HR, power, NP, cadence, training load and Training Effect, temperature (if weather downloaded), event_type when tagged (e.g. race). Use for "what did I do last week", finding an activity id, or comparing sessions. For one activity in depth use get_activity; for weekly/monthly totals use get_period_summary.

event_type.description: Only activities tagged with this event type, e.g. race

from.description: First day, inclusive; default no lower bound

max_duration_min.description: At most this many minutes long

min_duration_min.description: At least this many minutes long

name.description: Part of the activity name, any case, e.g. a route

pace.description: Average pace range per km, e.g. "4:45-5:30"

sort.description: By start time: desc newest first, asc oldest first

type.description: Garmin type key, e.g. running, trail_running, cycling, lap_swimming, strength_training; partial match. All keys: resource garmin://activity-types

name: get_activities
title: List activities
